title: Anglo-Dutch Gold Coast Treaty (1867)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Anglo-Dutch Gold Coast Treaty (1867)", at revision 1213006189, opens: "The Anglo-Dutch Gold Coast Treaty of 1867 redistributed forts along the Dutch and British Gold Coasts in order to concentrate the parties' areas of influence. All forts to the east of Fort Elmina were adopted by Britain, and all forts to the west by the Netherlands." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4763611, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1867 treaty between England and The Netherlands". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
